prompt:
How many kilometers of electric transmission line rated 345 kV or more run through FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area in Harris County, Texas?

Your working directory: /root/.cache/hifld-qgis-agent-errors/workspace/claude-haiku-5.5/Q7_1

output.method: I took the HIFLD Transmission Lines dataset (94,619 features) and kept lines with VOLTAGE >= 345 kV, which gave 345 kV segments only, with none above 345 kV in the Harris County area. I reprojected those lines and the Harris County NFHL flood zones (S_FLD_HAZ_AR, filtered to SFHA_TF = 'T', dissolved) to EPSG:3081, clipped the lines to the SFHA, and summed segment lengths: 30 clipped segments totalling 162.49 km.

args.sql: SELECT VOLTAGE, VOLT_CLASS, COUNT(*) AS n FROM tl WHERE VOLTAGE >= 345 AND bbox.xmin <= -94.9 AND bbox.xmax >= -95.95 AND bbox.ymin <= 30.18 AND bbox.ymax >= 29.5 GROUP BY VOLTAGE, VOLT_CLASS

I reprojected those lines and the Harris County NFHL flood zones (S_FLD_HAZ_AR, filtered to SFHA_TF = 'T', dissolved) to EPSG:3081, clipped the lines to the SFHA, and summed segment lengths: 30 clipped segments totalling 162.49 km."}
